regimes.name: Full Stick / Elastic Beam
regimes.mechanics_description: Normal confinement pressure prevents relative slip; strain is too low to trigger martensitic transformation. System behaves as a monolithic linear elastic beam.

regimes.name: Pure Wire Jamming (Small/Moderate Strains)
regimes.kinematic_condition: kappa_slip(p) <= kappa < kappa_tr and eps_max < eps_Ms (~0.75%)
regimes.mechanics_description: Frictional slip occurs between adjacent wires, modulating bending stiffness. However, NiTi remains 100% in linear elastic austenite phase (E = E_A = const). Zero phase transformation occurs. H0a fully predicts this regime! Scientific novelty collapses to conventional elastic wire jamming.

regimes.name: Coupled Transformation and Frictional Slip
regimes.mechanics_description: Both inter-wire slip and stress-induced martensitic transformation are simultaneously active. Requires deep bending curvature (bend radius < few cm) or substantial axial tensile preload.

coexistence_domain_reconstruction.critical_finding: In typical soft robotic bending (bending angles < 90 deg, curvature strains < 0.75%), operation falls entirely in Regime II (SLIP_ONLY). Coexistence requires specialized deep-flexure kinematics or axial tension.
coexistence_domain_reconstruction.remaining_uncertainty: Exact boundary kappa_tr(p) depends on inter-wire normal force distribution and packing geometry.

stiffness_definitions.tangent_stiffness: D_tan = dM/dkappa at constant pressure. Captures local stick-slip and transformation softening transitions; highly sensitive to loading branch.
stiffness_definitions.secant_stiffness: D_sec = (M - M0) / (kappa - kappa0). Global structural flexural metric; smooths out local slip/transformation jumps.
stiffness_definitions.dynamic_stiffness: D_dyn = (Delta M / Delta kappa) * cos(delta). Small-amplitude cyclic storage stiffness around prestrained state; reflects micro-stick bounds.

chamber_pressure_mapping.issue: Chamber pressure p does not map directly to inter-wire normal force f_n.
shielding_mechanisms: Membrane sleeve hoop tension: sigma_r = p - (t_mem / R_mem) * sigma_theta
Geometric arching and packing voids: outer wires shield inner core wires
End-cap axial tension effect from pressurized chamber

mechanism_confounding_matrix.observable: Softening slope on loading; energy dissipation in hysteresis loop
mechanism_confounding_matrix.local_measurement: DIC surface slip tracking, end-wire axial displacement differential
mechanism_confounding_matrix.confounders: Martensitic transformation softening, sleeve viscoelasticity, grip compliance
mechanism_confounding_matrix.discrimination_rule: Friction dissipation scales linearly with normal pressure and displacement; independent of temperature above Af.

mechanism_confounding_matrix.observable: Plateau flattening, pinched hysteresis neck, asymmetric tension-compression
mechanism_confounding_matrix.local_measurement: Infrared thermal imaging (latent heat of transformation), electrical resistance
mechanism_confounding_matrix.confounders: Inter-wire slip softening, cross-sectional ovalization / flattening
mechanism_confounding_matrix.independent_calibration: Single wire uniaxial tensile testing at controlled temperature (EA, EM, sigma_Ms)
mechanism_confounding_matrix.discrimination_rule: Transformation stress shifts linearly with temperature via Clausius-Clapeyron (6-8 MPa/K); friction does not.

mechanism_confounding_matrix.observable: Nonlinear stiffening at high confinement pressure
mechanism_confounding_matrix.local_measurement: Thin-film piezoresistive pressure sensor array inside bundle
mechanism_confounding_matrix.independent_calibration: Hydrostatic radial compression test without bending
mechanism_confounding_matrix.discrimination_rule: Pressure transmission factor alpha_trans calibrated under zero bending.

mechanism_confounding_matrix.observable: Drift in transformation plateau and residual strain accumulation
mechanism_confounding_matrix.local_measurement: Thermocouples embedded in bundle, cycle counter
mechanism_confounding_matrix.confounders: Frictional fretting wear, thermal self-heating from dissipation
mechanism_confounding_matrix.discrimination_rule: Low-frequency loading (< 0.05 Hz) ensures near-isothermal conditions.

experimental_identifiability_reconstruct.verdict_on_global_measurement: NON_IDENTIFIABLE from global force-displacement or moment-curvature measurements alone. Local instrumentation and decoupled calibrations are mandatory.
